### How to Live the Bible — Forgiving Debt
Author: Mel Lawrenz
Site: Bible Gateway Blog
URL: https://www.biblegateway.com/blog/2021/09/how-to-live-the-bible-forgiving-debt/
Passage: Leviticus 25:25, 28
Points:
- Unmanageable indebtedness places people in severe financial and personal bondage.
- In ancient Israel, difficult circumstances often forced impoverished families to forfeit their land.
- God established property redemption and the Jubilee to give people a second chance.
- The biblical principle of debt release encourages believers to extend generosity to those in need.
- Christians should look for practical opportunities to lift burdens and give others a break.

### Our Kinsman Redeemer
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/our-kinsman-redeemer
Passage: Leviticus 25:23–28
Points:
- The redemption laws protected impoverished Israelites by preventing permanent loss of family inheritances.
- A close relative was expected to step in and buy back property for a destitute kin.
- This Old Testament institution serves as a portrait of Christ as our Kinsman Redeemer.
- Jesus paid the moral debt of covenant-breakers on the cross rather than a mere financial cost.
- Believers are invited to rejoice in God's mercy, which secured an eternal inheritance.
